The assumptions are separate inputs to the derivations. In particular, a stronger paper bound must not be silently attributed to a separately reported formalization with a weaker bound. Source versions and locators below record provenance, not an independent correctness audit.

## sat26-general

For every fixed clause width w ≥ 2, assume the claimed deterministic exact-counting algorithm for w-CNF on N declared variables and M clauses. The model counts bit operations. Testing whether the count is positive decides SAT. This catalog assumes the statement; it does not certify it.

**Assumed time bound**

$$
(N+M)^{O_w(1)}2^{O_w(N\log\log N/\sqrt{\log N})}
$$

**Assumed space bound**

$$
(N+M)^{O_w(1)}
$$

- **`sat26-paper`** — [OpenAI, The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/42907c9e999cc00d6abe7a50bfc1023250edd1b9/preprints/The-Exponential-Time-Hypothesis-is-False-October-25-2026/paper.pdf). Version: 17 October 2026; revised 25 October 2026; Git commit 42907c9e999cc00d6abe7a50bfc1023250edd1b9. Locator: Theorem 1.1, general-density bound.

## sat26-sparse

Use only for fixed w and fixed D with M ≤ DN. If an encoding establishes N+M=O(s), where s is its declared parameter or size measure, add M new variables each forced to zero by a unit clause. This gives N′=N+M and M′=2M≤2N′, with exactly one extension per original satisfying assignment. The count-preserving padding is a catalog deduction; the assumed theorem and its pinned version are unchanged. See METHODS.md, Section 5. Free-variable padding is also valid if its known power-of-two multiplicity is corrected when counting.

**Assumed time bound**

$$
(N+M)^{O_{w,D}(1)}2^{O_{w,D}(N/\sqrt{\log N})}
$$

**Assumed space bound**

$$
(N+M)^{O_w(1)}
$$

- **`sat26-paper`** — [OpenAI, The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/42907c9e999cc00d6abe7a50bfc1023250edd1b9/preprints/The-Exponential-Time-Hypothesis-is-False-October-25-2026/paper.pdf). Version: 17 October 2026; revised 25 October 2026; Git commit 42907c9e999cc00d6abe7a50bfc1023250edd1b9. Locator: Theorem 1.1, fixed-density bound M ≤ DN.

## sat26-reported-formal

Separately assume the bound described by the published formalization scope for a deterministic machine on canonical encodings, where L_CNF is the bit length of that encoding. This exponent has an additional log log factor. No independent Lean replay has been performed for this starter catalog.

**Assumed time bound**

$$
(L_{\mathrm{CNF}}+1)^{O_w(1)}2^{O_w(N(\log\log N)^2/\sqrt{\log N})}
$$

**Assumed space bound**

$$
(L_{\mathrm{CNF}}+1)^{O_w(1)}
$$

- **`sat26-scope`** — [OpenAI, scope of the Lean formalization, lean/docs/378.md](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/42907c9e999cc00d6abe7a50bfc1023250edd1b9/lean/docs/378.md). Version: Git commit 42907c9e999cc00d6abe7a50bfc1023250edd1b9. Locator: Scope section.
